Name: Seasonal  Mariner To Mermaid
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
An all new Mariner to Mermaid replacer! Featuring original artwork and conversation for every season and situation.
Meet a new mermaid for every season! 

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/22799/22799-1771686102-570823395.png[/img]

[b][size=3]✧ Compatibility ✧
[i][size=1]Portraits added using Portraits for Vendors![/size][/i][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]New Portraits! Meet the mermaids face-to-face with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35358]They Deserve It Too - Portraits for Extras[/url]![/*]
[*]Unlock another mermaid visitor with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23881]Old Mariner Gives the Mermaid Her Pendant Back[/url] during stormy weather![/*]
[*]💖 Huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url] for sharing tech to help improve vendor mods and to make our collab possible![/*]
[/list]
   [b][color=#c9daf8]Additional portrait options ✧[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40375]Nyapu portraits[/url] from AhCuteArt! [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41761]Dacar style portraits[/url] in amazing HD![/*]
[*]Works seamlessly with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] (Seasonal Cute Characters) by Poltergeister![/*]
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10758]Maritime Secrets[/url] as well.[/*]
[/list]
